items.text: Seattle (early week): OUT - QB Sam Darnold (quad + cracked rib; targeting return after Wk11 bye), LG Quenton Nelson (knee procedure, week-to-week). Monitor - DT Leonard Williams (stinger), LT Charles Cross, OLB Uchenna Nwosu, WR Rashid Shaheed (knee), all missed Wk9. Drew Lock (oblique, elbow) expected to start, limited in practice; Jalen Milroe backup.
items.source: Seahawks.com (Updates on Darnold, Nelson & other injuries, Nov 9)

items.text: Las Vegas: Kirk Cousins traded to MIN Nov 10; rookie Fernando Mendoza takes over as starter per Schefter (Kubiak announcement pending). Monitor - Trey Zuhn III (concussion). No notable new injuries from the Wk9 loss at SF.
items.source: NBC Sports/Rotoworld (Mendoza to take over as Raiders starter, Nov 10)
